# Refinery29

> > Refinery29 is a modern media and entertainment platform delivering progressive content on pop culture, LGBTQ+ communities, lifestyle, and streaming entertainment across multiple languages.

Refinery29 covers entertainment trends including Netflix series analysis, film reviews, and streaming content recommendations. The site also provides cultural guides on LGBTQ+ terminology, seasonal lifestyle content, and pop culture commentary in both English and German.

## Key Topics

- Netflix original series
- Streaming content reviews
- LGBTQ+ culture and terminology
- Lesbian slang and gay lingo
- Pop culture analysis
- TV series commentary
- Film analysis
- German entertainment (Weihnachten)
- Queer community guides
- Shadow and Bone
- Élite
- Halston
- Six of Crows adaptations
- Progressive lifestyle content

## Entertainment & Streaming

- [TV, Stars, Kino & Kunst auf Refinery29.de](https://www.refinery29.com/de-de/entertainment?page=7): German entertainment content covering Netflix shows, film & pop culture

## LGBTQ+ Culture & Community

- [Lesbian Slang Terms, Gay Lingo Used By LGBT Community](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/lesbian-slang-terms-definitions): LGBTQ+ culture guide explaining lesbian slang and terminology

## Lifestyle & Seasonal

- [Weihnachten](https://www.refinery29.com/de-de/weihnachten?page=3): German Christmas content with gift ideas, recipes & festive tips
